hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that implements a full AMM backed by Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes via a bonding-curve invariant, deposits input tokens into the Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from the counterpart vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all pool accounting directly — bypassing standard CLAMM liquidity entirely.
